definition_en: a broad bend in a coastline, or a loop or slack bend in a rope
core_image: 海岸线弯出一臂宽的怀抱；绳上松松的一圈弯
scene: 船帆的绳子松出一弯，水手顺手把它收紧。The storm drove the boat into the wide bight of the coast.
sceneCN: 这里 bight 是「海湾」（第 1 个义项：海岸的大弧弯）；句意是风暴把小船吹进了海岸的大湾。

derivatives.zh: 同源异义近形词，义为「咬」，来自另一古英语词根
复合词，义为「用绳弯打的结」
同源远亲，义为「深渊」，同出希腊 bathys 词系

senses.title: A broad coastal curve
senses.definition: a long, gentle bend or curve in a coastline forming a bay
senses.definitionCN: 海岸线形成的宽缓弧弯，构成海湾
senses.example: The storm drove the boat into the wide bight of the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴把小船吹进了海岸的大湾。
senses.why: Old English byht meant a bend, of coasts as of anything else.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 byht 意为「弯曲」，先用于海岸等处。

senses.title: A loop of rope
senses.definition: the middle slack part of a rope bent into a U shape
senses.definitionCN: 绳子弯成 U 形时中部松弛的部分
senses.example: Pass the end through the bight and pull.
senses.exampleCN: 把绳端穿过绳圈后拉紧。
senses.why: A rope bends as a coast does; the bend names the loop.
senses.whyCN: 绳如海岸般弯曲，「弯」即得名绳圈。

senses.title: A curve or turn of any line
senses.definition: any bend or curve, as of a road, river, or line
senses.definitionCN: 道路、河流或线条的任何弯曲
senses.example: The road follows every bight of the river.
senses.exampleCN: 公路顺着河流的每一道弯。
senses.why: The bend idea generalizes beyond coasts.
senses.whyCN: 「弯曲」之义由海岸推广到一切线条。

senses.title: The bight in knot-tying
senses.definition: the U-shaped part used in making knots and hitches
senses.definitionCN: 打结、系索时所用的 U 形部分
senses.example: Tie the hitch on the bight for quick release.
senses.exampleCN: 把系结打在绳弯上以便快速解开。
senses.why: Riggers name the loop precisely because knots depend on it.
senses.whyCN: 索具工特意为绳圈命名，因为打结全赖它。

senses.title: A shallow bay as shelter
senses.definition: a bay shallow or curved enough to offer anchorage
senses.definitionCN: 水浅或弯度足以为船只提供泊地之湾
senses.example: The fleet sheltered in a grassy bight overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 船队夜宿于长满青草的小湾。
senses.why: A bend in the shore naturally shelters boats.
senses.whyCN: 岸的弯折天然庇护船只。

senses.title: A recess in geography
senses.definition: any concave bend or recess in land forms
senses.definitionCN: 陆地形态上的凹陷弯折
senses.example: The map marked a forested bight in the cliff line.
senses.exampleCN: 地图标出崖线上一处林木葱茏的凹弯。
senses.why: Coastline vocabulary migrates inland with maps.
senses.whyCN: 海岸词汇随地图向内陆迁移。

senses.title: The bight of a sail or tackle
senses.definition: the loop formed in a sail's sheet or tackle under load
senses.definitionCN: 帆的缭绳或索具受拉时形成的弯环
senses.example: Keep clear of the bight while the sail is loading.
senses.exampleCN: 帆受风拉紧时切勿靠近绳弯。
senses.why: Working ropes on ships keep the loop sense alive.
senses.whyCN: 船上作业的绳索让绳圈义沿用至今。

senses.title: Named coastal bights
senses.definition: a proper name element for great coastal indentations
senses.definitionCN: 用作大型海岸凹入的专名成分
senses.example: The Great Australian Bight stretches for hundreds of miles.
senses.exampleCN: 澳大利亚大湾绵延数百英里。
senses.why: Great bends on maps took the old word as a title.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的大弯以古词为名。

intro.en: Bight is an old English word for a bend, related to bow.
intro.cn: bight 是古英语「弯」的词汇，与 bow 同源。

items.en: the root bheug- meant to bend; reconstructed form.
items.cn: 词根 bheug- 意为「弯曲」（重构形式）。

items.en: byht meant a bend, a corner, related to būgan, to bend.
items.cn: 古英语 byht 意为「弯、角」，与 būgan「弯曲」相关。

items.en: buhtiz covered bends of land and rope alike.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼语 buhtiz 兼指陆地与绳索之弯。

items.en: bight named both coastal bends and rope loops.
items.cn: 中古英语 bight 兼指海岸弯与绳圈。

items.en: now nautical and geographical, from knot manuals to map names.
items.cn: 如今用于航海与地理，见于结绳手册与地图名称。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bend root or the spelling; the near-meaning group gathers coastal and rope words.
note.cn: 形近组共享「弯曲」词根或拼写；近义组汇集海岸与绳索类词。

entries.definitionCN: 弯曲；弓形——同出 bheug- 词根

entries.definition: a broad inlet of the sea
entries.definitionCN: 海湾——与 bight 意义相邻

entries.definition: a large deep inlet of the sea
a shape bending round and closed
a narrow strip of water reaching inland

normalIntro.en: Bight is the old word for a bend — of coasts and of ropes.
normalIntro.cn: bight 是「弯」的古词——既弯海岸，也弯绳索。

normal.en: The Great Australian Bight is the famous example.
normal.cn: 澳大利亚大湾是著名例子。

normal.en: In knots, the bight is the U part.
normal.cn: 结绳术语中，bight 指 U 形部分。

normal.en: It comes from Old English byht.
It shares a root with bow and bend.

abstract.en: See the coastline cup its hands around the sea.
abstract.cn: 看海岸线掬起双手环抱大海。

abstract.en: Feel the soft loop of rope ready to receive the end.
abstract.cn: 感受松松的绳圈正候着绳端穿入。

abstract.en: Picture a river drawing one lazy curve after another.
abstract.cn: 想象河流画出一道又一道慵懒的弯。

examples.en: The storm drove the boat into the wide bight of the coast.
examples.cn: 风暴把小船吹进了海岸的大湾。

examples.en: Pass the end through the bight and pull.
examples.cn: 把绳端穿过绳圈后拉紧。

examples.en: The Great Australian Bight stretches for hundreds of miles.
examples.cn: 澳大利亚大湾绵延数百英里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「掰特」——海岸被掰出一道弯，绳子被掰出一个圈。

root: 古英语 byht「弯、角」，源自原始日耳曼语 buhtiz，上溯至原始印欧语 bheug-「弯曲」（重构形式），与 būgan「弯曲」及 bow 同根；中古英语 bight 兼指海岸弯与绳圈，现代用于航海与地理。

sensesIntro.en: One old word for bend splits into the sea's embrace and the rope's soft loop.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个古老的「弯」分化为大海的怀抱与绳索的软圈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line bending into an open curve
core.cn: 核心意象：线条弯出一段开放的弧

intro.en: Bight is a bare Germanic noun from the bend root.
intro.cn: bight 是「弯曲」词根的日耳曼光杆名词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin; the bight family is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同族；bight 词族属日耳曼语系。
